info.title: ShipAggregator API
info.description:
TR-Only Shipping Aggregation Backend API.

## Authentication

- **Dashboard Auth**: Session-based authentication for ops/admin users
- **API Key Auth**: Bearer token authentication for customer integrations

## Idempotency

Endpoints marked with `Idempotency-Key` header requirement must include a unique
client-generated key. Duplicate requests with the same key return the original response.

## Pagination

List endpoints use cursor-based pagination with `cursor` and `limit` query parameters.

## Error Handling

All errors follow RFC 7807 Problem Details format with additional `code` and `trace_id` fields.
